feat: add --threshold option to frai eval for CI gating

Adds ability to gate CI pipelines on metric score thresholds. Exit code reflects
result: 0 for success, 1 when thresholds fail, 2 for usage errors (malformed
threshold or unknown metric).

Changes to CLI (frai-cli):
- Add --threshold <metric>=<min> option (repeatable)
- Parse and validate threshold format and range (0.0-1.0)
- Pass thresholds to generateReport()
- Handle exit codes: 2 on parse error, 1 when report.passed=false
- Wrap generateReport and writeReport in try-catch for consistent error handling
- Support custom metrics in threshold names (lowercase, underscore, digits)

Changes to Core SDK (frai-core):
- Extend generateReport() to accept optional thresholds object
- Implement evaluateThresholds() logic: score must be non-null and >= min
- Add report.passed field (boolean) and report.thresholds array to all reports
- Update JSON reporter: automatically includes new fields via JSON.stringify
- Update Markdown reporter: add "## Thresholds" section with PASS/FAIL status
- Throw error with valid metric list if threshold references unknown metric

Tests:
- Added 25+ test cases across three test files
- frai-cli/src/index.test.ts: 6 cases for CLI parsing and validation
- frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js: 8 cases for generateReport + 2 for reporters
- frai-core/src/eval/thresholds.test.js: 10 dedicated threshold test cases
- Coverage: threshold pass/fail, null scores, boundary values (0.0, 1.0),
           multiple thresholds, unknown metrics, backward compatibility

Documentation:
- Updated CLI README with --threshold option description and examples
- Added SDK example showing threshold usage in programmatic context
- Documented exit codes and error handling

Backward compatibility:
- All changes are additive; without --threshold option, behavior unchanged
- generateReport() without thresholds parameter works exactly as before
- Exit code 0 when no thresholds specified

Code review fixes:
- Fixed decimal validation to reject malformed values like "0.9.5"
- Added try-catch around writeReport for consistent error handling
- Extended metric name pattern to support custom metrics

Fixes: Request to gate CI on eval metrics — allow thresholds on eval command
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
